mechanism_comment: Bazedoxifene profile is antagonistic in breast and endometrial tissue, while an estrogen agonist in bone tissue;  Bazedoxifene in combination with conjugated estrogens is the first approved tissue-selective estrogen receptor complex (TSEC)
Ph2 study for indication Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia was terminated, drug in Ph2 trial for Schizophrenia.
Activates some estrogen pathways and blocks other estrogen pathways.
FDA accepted IND-application in December 2014. Is a SERM (selective estrogen receptor modulator) and SERD (selective estrogen receptor down-regulator/degrader)
